name: Bird-Shaped Container (zun)
summary: Bronze。15.9 × 13.3 × 5.7 cm (6 1/4 × 5 1/4 × 2 1/4 in.)。Lucy Maud Buckingham Collection
history: Animal-shaped vessels are the rarest of all Shang ritual bronzes. This creature is a fascinating blend of alert poise and solemn dignity. Whereas the scaled pattern on the neck and tail of this bird suggests feathers, other details are fantastic rather than anatomical. A dragon in profile and a coiled serpent embellish each wing; monster masks crown the head as well as the removable lid on the bird's back.
